result.title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
result.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/MathisImm/persona-vlm-representations; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23664820
result.summary: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.

AI.brief_summary: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，以 100 张图像、53 种提示条件系统性改变 persona 内容与语言框架，同时记录行为评分与逐层隐状态，考察 persona 条件化视觉趣味判断的表征几何，并发现表征变化与行为判断出现分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「内部状态是否被实际使用」这一核心问题：分层结果显示早期层偏图像身份、后层才出现 persona 结构，且框架对表征的影响强于 persona 身份、对行为的影响却相反，可供核查 latent 相似度解读中深度、内容与功能因果性的混淆。
